mekki-muskil:6-6.t: His saying, the Exalted: (ما غرك): (ما) is an interrogative, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (غرك) is the khabar (predicate).

mekki-muskil:17-17.t: His saying (وما أدراك ما يوم الدين): the discussion of it and of its parallel has already preceded in al-Ḥāqqa, al-Wāqiʿa and elsewhere.

mekki-muskil:19-19.t: His saying (يوم لا تملك نفس لنفس شيئا): whoever reads (يوم) with fatḥa makes it in the position of the nominative as a badal (substitute) from the (يوم) before it, or in the position of the accusative as an adverbial, or as a badal from the first (يوم الدين). It is indeclinable (mabnī) according to the Kufans because it is annexed to the verb, and declinable according to the Basrans, accusative as a badal from the first (يوم); and its accusative as an adverbial of the recompense, which is (الدين), is permissible. It is not indeclinable according to them only because it is annexed to a declinable word; it is made indeclinable only when annexed to an indeclinable one, like (يومئذ). Whoever reads it in the nominative makes it a badal from the (يوم الدين) before it, and it may be put in the nominative with an implied (هو).
